meta_description: JH Gardens Sheffield — reliable local gardening services for garden maintenance, landscaping, and seasonal work. Free quotes available. Call 07525 784065.
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to seasonal maintenance, JH Gardens keeps your Sheffield garden looking its best year-round.
services_subhead: Whether you need spring pruning, lawn care, hedge trimming, or a full garden redesign, we've got you covered.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular lawn mowing, border tidying, and seasonal weeding. Keep your garden cared for without the effort.

services.title: Hedge & Tree Trimming
services.desc: Safe, professional pruning and hedge cutting. We shape overgrown trees and keep boundaries neat and tidy.

services.title: Garden Clearance
services.desc: Reclaim overgrown or neglected gardens. We clear debris, remove dead wood, and leave your plot ready for a fresh start.

services.title: Lawn Care & Seeding
services.desc: Restore patchy lawns with expert scarifying, aeration, and quality seed. Enjoy a thick, healthy green carpet.

services.title: Planting & Garden Design
services.desc: Transform bare spaces with thoughtful planting schemes. We suggest hardy shrubs, perennials, and seasonal colour.

services.title: Patio & Pathway Cleaning
services.desc: Remove moss, algae, and grime from hard surfaces. Pressure washing brings patios and steps back to life safely.

about_pullquote: I built this business because I love seeing gardens thrive and customers smile.
about_para_1: JH Gardens has been serving Sheffield and Penistone for over 12 years. We started with a simple idea: offer reliable, honest gardening work at fair prices. What began as one person with a van has grown into a trusted local business, but we've never lost sight of why we do this — to help homeowners enjoy their outdoor space.
about_para_2: We're known for turning up on time, getting the job done right, and treating your garden with the same care we'd give our own. Many of our customers have been with us for years, moving from monthly maintenance to seasonal projects and the occasional spring refresh. That's because we listen, we explain what needs doing, and we don't oversell.

reviews.text: Had my garden completely done over — it was a right mess before. JH came in, cleared everything, and planted some lovely shrubs and perennials. Now it actually looks nice. Can't recommend enough.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Been using JH for the hedge trimming for about three years now. Always reliable, always does a good job, and doesn't charge the earth. Turns up when he says he will. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: Called for a patio clean and got a quote the same day. The work was done quickly and the patio looks brand new. Fair price, friendly bloke, and the moss and slime is completely gone.
reviews.author: Jennifer P.
